card.name: Words just before a listed continuation
card.fires_on: Scattered small words, commas and word parts that come right before a list, a range or a restatement, such as 'contains the', 'a variety of', 'two options for' and 'dosage range'. The cue is that a specific item or set is about to be named.

modes.label: Linking words before a list
modes.description: Small words or commas after which a set of items or options is introduced.
modes.example: Also consumes a<< variety>> of animal foods, including both insects and vertebrates.

modes.label: Dosage phrasing
modes.description: Commas or nouns in dosing sentences just before an amount or range.
modes.example: The recommended dosage<< range>> is 3 mg to 6 mg

modes.label: Partway through animal terms
modes.description: The middle of a diet word such as omnivores.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a list, option or range is spelled out.
